_comment: The texts of Test Drive Unlimited's README that are its own (tools/title_readme.py has the common ones).

screens.alt: Test Drive Unlimited's airport intro, running recompiled on PC
The title screen, drawn by Any360's Vulkan renderer

pitch: It continues the TDU rewrite project as a recompilation of the Xbox 360 version with ReXGlue v0.10.0, then moves it off the emulation layers.
own_copy: You need your own copy of the game (European disc, title 494707D4); the recompiled C++ is generated on your machine from your disc's `default.xex`.

state.recompiled: `default.xex` fully translated (45,102 functions; 53 the analyzer misses are declared in [config/](config/)); boots to the title, plays its intro videos and drives on the island, with sound and gamepad
state.library: five memory functions (`memcpy`, its forward copy, `memmove`, `memset`, the vector copy), compared with the game's own code on every call in game (14 M calls past the title screen for the first three)
state.game: not started (the count is in the table above)

run: `--any360_gpu=true` draws the whole game through `any360::gfx` (`--any360_gpu_scale=2 --any360_gpu_msaa=4`; `--any360_gpu_vblank_hz=240` for frame rates above 60); `--any360_sys_groups` puts the Xbox system calls on `any360::sys` (checked to the title screen; driving, saves and sound still to check). The library functions run on `any360::xdk` by default (`--any360_xdk_natives=false` runs the game's own; `--any360_xdk_verify=true` runs both on every call and compares them).
build: Windows, Visual Studio 2022 with the C++ and Clang tools, an install of the ReXGlue SDK v0.10.0 (`-Sdk`, the folder with `bin\rexglue.exe`, `include\` and `lib\`) and an [Any360](https://github.com/GaetanVigner/Any360) checkout (`-Any360`).
1. Extract your disc into `game\` (for example with [extract-xiso](https://github.com/XboxDev/extract-xiso)), so that `game\default.xex` exists.
4. Run `out\build\tdu.exe`. It finds `game\` next to itself or in the repository; logs are written to `out\build\logs\`.

Code reached only through vtables or data pointers is invisible to the codegen: [tools/find-missing-functions.py](tools/find-missing-functions.py) scans the decrypted image for such targets and writes them to [config/discovered-functions.toml](config/discovered-functions.toml). The project's first page, with why it was started, is kept in [docs/LEGACY_README.md](docs/LEGACY_README.md).
credits: Test Drive Unlimited by Eden Games, published by Atari (2006).
The TDU rewrite project's earlier authors (Grien25, CRACKbomber, testdriveupgrade) and [XenonRecompUnlimited](https://github.com/testdriveupgrade/XenonRecompUnlimited).
legal: An unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Atari or Eden Games. It is not a replacement for the game: you still need to own a copy, and nothing of the game is in this repository.
